scene.codegen: block merge and animation fusion on

visualCheck: The foreground water-wave artwork is missing in the reduced scene. Fighters, playable platforms, trees, terrain and HUD remain framed normally. This is a visible cosmetic reduction, not invisible offscreen culling.
decision: Keep native water by default; both pairs gain FPS, but the smaller gain is 0.60, the visual loss is visible, and every 30-second gate still fails. The optional mode passed its separate gameplay/Randall/camera replay.
limits: One heavy Yoshi matchup, not all characters or physical input-to-photon latency. Graphics bytes intentionally differ.
